summaries.refunds: For a paid Trayage license, use the policy for your purchase route. The app’s refund page explains direct purchases and Apple-billed purchases.

summaries.refunds: StylePort is free, open source, and still in development. Optional support payments are separate from an app purchase. Check the information shown at checkout and contact support about a payment.
summaries.privacy: Covers StylePort’s local styles and settings, Safari website access, its website, and optional support payments.
summaries.terms: StylePort is free and open source under GPL-3.0. Its website explains its development status and any optional support payment; support does not buy a license or unlock features.

summaries.refunds: Drift is free. Optional support links use the payment services identified on Drift’s website. For a support-payment question, use that service’s receipt and contact details.
summaries.privacy: Covers the Chrome extension’s local preferences, temporary drafts, Mastodon handoff, and the Drift website.
summaries.terms: Drift is free, open source, and MIT-licensed. Optional support payments do not unlock extension features.
